name: role_convention
quote: The trainee identifies the clinical problem, recognises that a medicine may be needed, communicates it, and initiates the appropriate workflow (e.g. asks the senior/anaesthetist, flags it on the drug chart for confirmation). A qualified clinician confirms the final treatment decision and dose; a nurse or clinician administers.

name: never_prescribe
quote: The trainee never independently prescribes, selects a dose for, or administers a patient-specific medicine.

name: PATIENT_SPECIFIC
quote: PATIENT-SPECIFIC DOSE — CLINICIAN CONTROLLED — the simulator shows the decision (e.g. 'a strong painkiller titrated by the clinician') but not a number.

name: EDUCATIONAL_EXAMPLE
quote: EDUCATIONAL EXAMPLE DOSE (SOURCE-BACKED) — NOT A TRAINEE PRESCRIPTION — shown only where an authoritative source gives a standard adult dose (named beside it)
